title: Classes in Practice (Project 1 briefs)
description: The F10 Project day briefs: modeling a real-world object as a class, handling null safely, and building with Maven dependencies, each with a starter scaffold and public tests.
sourceCoverageNotes: Course slice: Foundation days F4-F18 (curriculum/snapshot/pep-curriculum.json /tracks/0/weeks/0/days/3 to /tracks/0/weeks/3/days/2). This module covers F10 (/tracks/0/weeks/1/days/4).
Module order follows authoring batches: by calendar day F10 falls between F9 and F11, so learners meet these briefs after the F9 topics of classes-and-objects and before its F11 topics.
Module grouping is a second-mate grouping decision recorded at intake (matrix record source-gap-java-foundations-modules), not syllabus: modules follow calendar day order and hold 4-9 topics.
Every calendar row of these days maps to exactly one topic with relation exact; there are no splits or shared rows.

F10 is a Project day: each of its three rows is one reusable learner-facing project brief (kind lab-brief, because the topic schema has no project kind) with a topic coding lab holding the starter scaffold and public tests, test command mvn -q -o test (captain decision pep-project-rows, option A; intake reconciliation education-01 and java-sme-001). The same canonical brief is reused by the Standard and Fast overlays.
